The Consolidated financials results were reviewed by the Audit Committee on October 16, 2026 and were thereafter approved by the Board at its meeting held on October 16, 2026.
The consolidated financial results relate to Aurum PropTech Group. The Group consists of Aurum PropTech Limited ( 'the Company' ) and its Subsidiaries and Associates mentioned below :
K2V2 Technologies Private Limited, subsidiary
Liv Real Solutions Private Limited, wholly owned subsidiary
Monk Tech Labs Pte. Limited, wholly owned foreign subsidiary
HelloWorld Technologies Private Limited, wholly owned subsidiary
Integrow Asset Management Private Limited, subsidiary till June 30, 2025, Associate from July 1, 2025
Aurum Analytica Private Limited , wholly owned subsidiary
Monk Tech Venture Private Limited, subsidiary
YieldWiseX Technologies Private Limited , wholly owned subsidiary
Cuneate Services Private Limited, wholly owned subsidiary
NestAway Technologies Private Limited, subsidiary
Bonds Brain Technologies Private Limited, wholly owned subsidiary
NestAway PropTech Mena Realestate LLC, wholly owned foreign subsidiary
PropTiger Marketing Services Private Limited, wholly owned subsidiary, w.e.f. September 26, 2025
Helloworld Living Private Limited, wholly owned subsidiary of HelloWorld Technologies Private Limited, w.e.f. December 31, 2025
Locon Solutions Private Limited, wholly owned subsidiary, w.e.f. September 29, 2026
The Company had issued 4,29,44,533 equity shares of face value of INR 5/- each on right basis ( 'Rights Equity Shares'). In accordance with the terms of issue, INR 20/- (including a premium of INR 18.75 per share ) i.e. 25% of the Issue Price per Rights Equity Share, was received from the concerned allottees on application and shares were allotted. The Company made First call of INR 30/- per Rights Equity Share (including a premium of INR 28.13 per share) in March 2024.

The Company made Second and Final call of INR 30/- per Rights Equity Share (including a premium of INR 28.12 per share) in March 2025 along with a reminder for the First call unpaid.

During the year ended March 31, 2026, the Company received INR 12,772 lakhs ( including premium of INR 11,971 lakhs ) on account of 4,25,71,789 shares against the Second and Final call . The Company also received INR 678 lakhs (including premium of INR 635 lakhs ) on account of 22,58,944 shares against the First call. These 4,25,71,789 shares are fully paid as at March 31, 2026.

During the period ended September 30, 2026, the Company received INR 3 lakhs against the Second and Final call money. The Company completed the corporate action for the call monies received and 30,047 shares were issued as fully paid. In total 4,26,01,836 shares are fully paid as at September 30, 2026. The balance 3,42,697 shares which are not fully paid due to unpaid call money are not available for trading. The calls that remained unpaid (i) both the First and Second call - INR 161 lakhs (including premium of INR 151 lakhs ) for 2,67,565 shares at INR 60/- per share (ii) only the Second call - INR 23 lakhs (including premium of INR 21 lakhs ) for 75,132 shares at INR 30/- per share .

During the half year ended September 30, 2026, the Company has received INR 1 lakhs as interest for late payment of call money, which has been considered as Other income in the Consolidated Profit and Loss statement.

The Board of Directors of the Company, at its meeting held on July 16, 2026, approved the acquisition of 100% of the share capital of Locon Solutions Private Limited (“Locon” / “Housing.com”) from REA India Pte. Ltd., Singapore (“REA India”), by way of an all-stock equity swap. The consideration of INR 45,806 lakhs is to be discharged through the issue of 1,97,93,309 fully paid-up equity shares of the Company, having a face value of INR 5/- each, to REA India on a preferential basis. The Company discharged the consideration by issue of such number of shares on September 29, 2026.

The Company acquired control of Locon with effect from September 29, 2026, and Locon has accordingly been consolidated as a subsidiary in accordance with IND AS 110, Consolidated Financial Statements. In accordance with IND AS 103, Business Combinations, the identifiable assets (including intangible assets) and liabilities of Locon have been recognised in the consolidated financial statements at their provisional fair values, based on a purchase price allocation carried out by an independent valuer, and the resultant goodwill has been recognised. Any necessary adjustments to these provisional amounts will be made within the measurement period.

The Board of Directors of the Company, at its meeting held on July 16, 2026, considered and approved the issue of 51,00,000 (Fifty-One Lakh) Fully Convertible Warrants (“Warrants”) at a price of INR 231.421 per Warrant, aggregating to INR 11,802.47 lakhs, for cash consideration, on a preferential basis to Aurum RealEstate Developers Limited (“AREDL”), a Promoter and existing shareholder of the Company.

In accordance with the terms of the issue, the Company received INR 2,950.62 lakhs on October 13, 2026, representing 25% of the Warrant issue price, and the Board of Directors, on October 13, 2026, approved the allotment of the Warrants to AREDL. The balance 75% of the issue price shall be payable by AREDL at the time of exercise of the Warrants. AREDL may exercise the Warrants, in one or more tranches, at its option, within a period of 18 months from the date of allotment.

The Board of Directors of the Company, at its meeting held on July 23, 2025, approved the acquisition of up to 100% of the share capital of PropTiger Marketing Services Private Limited (“PropTiger”) from REA India Pte. Ltd., Singapore (“REA India”), by way of an all-stock equity swap. The consideration of INR 8,645 lakhs was to be discharged through the issue of 42,42,537 fully paid-up equity shares of the Company, having a face value of INR 5 each, to REA India on a preferential basis (“Preferential Issue”).

The Company acquired control of PropTiger with effect from September 25, 2025, and PropTiger has accordingly been consolidated as a subsidiary in accordance with Ind AS 110, Consolidated Financial Statements. In accordance with Ind AS 103, Business Combinations, the identifiable assets (including intangible assets) and liabilities of PropTiger have been recognised in the consolidated financial statements at their fair values, based on a purchase price allocation carried out by an independent valuer, and the resultant goodwill has been recognised.

During the previous year ended March 31, 2026, on the issue of equity shares to REA India, the Company credited INR 212 lakhs to share capital and INR 8,433 lakhs to securities premium.

The Company was holding 49.13% of the equity share capital of Integrow Asset Management Private Limited ( Integrow ), and by virtue of its right to exercise majority control in the Board of Integrow, consolidates its financial results as a subsidiary in accordance with IND AS 110. However considering a prospective restructuring of the equity of Integrow, the Company w.e.f . July 1, 2025 has kept the right to exercise majority control in the Board of Integrow in abeyance until March 31, 2027. Accordingly in the consolidated financial statements of the Company, Integrow has been treated as a 'subsidiary' for the quarter ended June 30, 2025 and as an 'investment in associate' from July 1, 2025.

As approved by the Board of Directors of the Company in its meeting held on October 16, 2025, the Company during the year ended March 31, 2026, has sold 0.97% of its holding in Integrow, for a consideration of INR 66 lakhs and made a profit of INR 42 lakhs, which was shown under Other income. The Company as on September 30, 2026 holds 48.16% of the equity share capital of Integrow.

The Company in FY 2023-24 has incorporated a subsidiary in Dubai, UAE namely Nestaway PropTech MENA Real Estate LLC ( formerly known as Aurum PropTech MENA LLC ). During the previous year ended March 31, 2026, the Company has invested INR 546 lakhs as equity capital in the subsidiary.

During the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, the Company has further invested INR 101.63 lakhs (AED 3.83 lakhs) in Nestaway PropTech MENA Real Estate LLC.

During the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, the Company has invested INR 92 lakhs for acquiring 6,421 CCPS of NestAway Technologies Private Limited, and increased its holding to 99.78%.
The Board of Directors of the Company in its meeting held on October 16, 2025, approved the purchase of 3,826 equity shares of K2V2 Technologies Private Limited (K2V2) for a consideration of INR 634 lakhs. During the previous year ended March 31, 2026, the Company completed the acquisition of the shares and increased its holding in K2V2 to 90.14%.
The Company is developing new products whose feasibility has been established, enhancing and increasing functionality of existing technology / softwares with a clear objective of deriving future economic benefit from the same. In the process the Company during the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, has capitalised INR 374 lakhs and INR 711 lakhs respectively mainly on account of cost incurred on its own product team and management team directly involved in development of intangibles.
During the quarter and half year ended ended September 30, 2026, Company has recognised deferred tax liability of INR 133 lakhs and INR 267 lakhs respectively.
On March 06, 2026, two wholly owned Subsidiaries of the Company viz Aurum Softwares and Solutions Private Limited (ASSL) and Liv Real Solutions Private Limited (LIV) had filed a scheme of Arrangement with Regional Director II, Western region (Mumbai) having Appointed date of April 01, 2025, wherein ASSL will be merged into LIV. The confirmation order of scheme of merger was received on May 15, 2026 and the effect of the order was given in the financial statements as on March 31, 2026.
Discontinued operations :

The Board of Directors of the Company, at its meeting held on March 12, 2026, approved the sale of Buildings owned by the Company at Navi Mumbai, for a consideration of approximately INR 11,200 lakhs. During the quarter ended June 30, 2026, the Company closed the sale transaction at INR 11,200 lakhs.

The Buildings derive Rental income, and the financial performance from its operations is shown under the Rental segment. As required by IND AS 105, Non-current Assets Held for Sale and Discontinued Operations, the financial performance of the Buildings and the assets / liabilities have been shown separately under Discontinued Operations in these financial statements, for the quarter and half year ended September 30,2026 and also for the comparative periods / year.

The Company during the year ended March 31, 2026 has transferred the possession of a floor in the buildings to the buyer and consequently recognised a gain of INR 1,772 lakhs attributable to the floor in the buildings as Other income from Discontinued Operations. During the quarter ended June 30, 2026 the balance gain of INR 5,235 lakhs has been recognised as Other income from Discontinued Operations and sale transaction was concluded.
Items that will not be reclassified to profit or loss represents remeasurement of defined benefit obligation. Items that will be reclassified to profit or loss represents exchange differences on translation of foreign operations.
0 denotes amount less than INR 0.5 lakhs, earning per share is rounded up to two decimal places.
Previous period's / year's figures have been regrouped and reclassified wherever necessary.
